verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a billing product, since open-source billing systems exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe Billing's own source is published under an open license. The stripe/openapi repository holds API specifications, not product source, so it is only an adjacent artifact and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
